caption.en:
A distributor told me something I haven't stopped thinking about.

I asked: "What's the hardest part of managing stock across your three warehouses?"

He said: "Honestly? The phone calls. Every morning, I call the three warehouse managers. Every morning, I hear three different versions of the truth."

Three versions of the truth. Not because anyone was lying — because each manager sees their own warehouse, and nobody sees all three.

That's not a people problem. It's a visibility problem.

What's the hardest part for you? 👇

Book a meeting with our team.
caption.ar:
تاجر قلّي شي ما عم يطلع من راسي.

سألتو: «شو أصعب شي بإدارة المخزون بالـ٣ مستودعات تبعك؟»

قلّي: «بصراحة؟ التلفونات. كل صبح بتّصل بمدراء الـ٣ مستودعات. وكل صبح بسمع ٣ نسخ مختلفة من الحقيقة.»

٣ نسخ من الحقيقة. مش لأنو حدا عم يكذب — لأنو كل مدير شايف مستودعو، وما حدا شايف التلاتة.

هيدي مش مشكلة ناس. هيدي مشكلة رؤية.

شو أصعب شي عندك؟ 👇

احجز اجتماعاً مع فريقنا.

extra.linkedin_en.txt:
A distributor told me something last week that I haven't stopped thinking about.

I asked: "What's the hardest part of managing stock across your three warehouses?"

I expected him to say "the software" or "the reporting."

He said: "Honestly? It's the phone calls. Every morning, I call the three warehouse managers. Every morning, I hear three different versions of the truth."

Three different versions of the truth.

Not because anyone was lying. Because each manager sees their own warehouse, and nobody sees all three.

That's not a people problem. It's a visibility problem.

And it's the reason Stacko works the way it does — one map, all locations, one version of the truth.

If you manage stock across multiple locations, I'd love to hear: what's the hardest part for you?

👇
